notes.title: Want to be featured in a video game? + The Test: Secrets of the Soul releasing!
notes.content:
[b] Hello everyone!

This title, plus ALL of our other titles will be going on sale in our Deluxe Bundle with a link below!

We also just want to announce that The Test: Secrets of the Soul will be releasing TODAY for FREE, along with an optional DLC if you wish to support us further.


Also, we have taken some of your names from the comments you've left for us on previous titles, and started working them into our future releases! We will be going back through and reading old comments, as well as new comments on ALL of our past and future releases and choosing names from them to add to our new Fateweaver Series!

If you wish to participate, please add these titles to your Wishlist!

The first Fateweaver title releases 2/27/2023 at 10:00 AM 

And The Test: Secrets of the Soul releases in only a matter of MINUTES!

Many have asked this question:

Is it too late to leave my secret word on previous titles to participate in future events?

Our Answer:

[i]No! It is NEVER too late to participate by leaving your secret words on past titles! We always read new words left and you'll never go unnoticed! If you've left a comment from a long time ago, or if you're new to our games, we will make sure both are taken into account when selecting players to be a part of our games. Even titles released years ago are STILL completely active in terms of Secret Words and comments and we often go back through and select both OLD and NEW players to be a part of future projects! (As seen in the new Fateweaver Series.)[/i]

Thank you so much for all of your continued support! The links we've provided below will be the best way to Wishlist these upcoming titles and we hope to hear more from you tomorrow, and in the following weeks.

Have an absolutely wonderful day! We appreciate you dearly!

- Randumb Studios


[/b]

notes.title: Secret Words + New Games + Steam Deck Verification!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

Some announcements we'd like to make:

The Horrorscope is now officially Steam Deck Verified!
The Test Trilogy is also officially Steam Deck Verified including The Test: Final Revelation!

We are currently working on the development of multiple other titles as well as Chasing Demons.

We'd also like to mention for those who have been wondering if it's too late to provide Secret Words on our titles. The answer to that question is:

"It is NEVER too late to participate with your secret words or votes on our games!"

We will always find a use for the words you provide and every word is useful for Chasing Demons, as well as a few other projects we're currently working on that we're excited to announce in the near future!

We are still in need of more votes for The Advisor - Episode 1 in order for us to finish development on The Advisor - Episode 2, so if you haven't done so yet, please make sure you provide your votes on whether Magnus should leave, or stay, and we will credit you for your participation in the credits of Episode 2!

Your Secret Words will come in handy for each and every one of our titles, (Including The Test Trilogy) and will play a pretty pivotal role in upcoming projects.

For those of you who haven't played all of our games, you can find them heavily discounted and currently on sale in our Deluxe Bundle below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

Thank you so much for your participation and support, and we look forward to hearing more from you in the future!

- Randumb Studios[/b]
